scientific_integrity: Analytical Dirichlet resolvent and Parseval proof; finite grid and two exact normalization examples checked with an embedded standalone script. Publication priority remains subject to external review.
scientific_limitations: Entire spatial boundary absorbing; uniform independent initial position and heading; positive translational diffusivity; chirality ordering only at quadratic weak-swimming order; no all-swim-speed chirality ordering or reflecting-boundary extension.
title: Shape-universal chirality suppression of weak-swimming escape enhancement
